correctness.rationale: The exact ODE is admissible and smooth near the studied equilibrium. The two mode blocks have determinants 11/30 and 1/2-w, proving the full stability threshold. The simple center eigenvalue at w=1/2 has cubic coefficient 164/11 > 0, proving nonlinear instability. An invertible two-equation equilibrium reduction yields branch slope -246/11 < 0 and precisely two nearby unstable nonsynchronous equilibria for w just below 1/2. The standalone exact-arithmetic symbolic checker reconstructs all critical identities; no finite experiment substitutes for the analytic implications.

value.rationale: The motivating epidemic-opinion paper leaves stability under unsynchronized perturbations unresolved while proving attraction only for synchronous initial data. This exact model demonstrates a sharp reversal: greater opinion connectivity destabilizes a locally attracting endemic equilibrium, and the nonlinear calculation identifies a subcritical rather than restoring symmetry-breaking transition. This is a motivated parameter boundary and a substantive counterexample to extending synchronous attraction to the full epidemic-opinion network; the result does not claim a universal effect.
